title: Daily life and caution in New York
summary: He has barely changed his behavior, going out by bicycle for equipment and daily for food.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you change your behavior as New York City got worse and now it’s getting better?

I didn’t change yet my behavior. You know the only thing that maybe I do just a little, I go out a little bit more, you know, but not for fun. I just go out if I need something. Like I’ve been fooling around with a little bit of recording equipment. I bought a microphone. So I’ll go to the B&H Shop by bicycle wearing the mask, and if something all of a sudden comes to my mind, I need a cable, then I’ll get the bicycle and go you know. While in the first few weeks I would just go downstairs once a week to buy food. Now I go downstairs to the market every day to buy food, because it’s just downstairs. So that’s about it.
